ABOUT / THE PROJECT

Life counter, games
and statistics.

21Life is a Commander game tracker that brings together a life counter, shared history and player and deck analytics.

01

Life counter

Start a game and put your phone in the middle of the table. One life counter for the whole group.

02

Match history

Who won, which deck they played, who they faced. Your group’s games are saved for everyone to look back on.

03

Statistics

How is your new deck doing? Who wins most often? Compare players and decks across the games you play.

DECKS & IMPORTS

The decks you play.
The results they get.

Import your decks from Archidekt or Moxfield and use them in your games. Statistics help you see which ones perform best in your group.

  • Rankings for players, decks and commanders
  • Playgroup seasons and awards
  • Personal statistics and winning streaks
  • Optional public group results
  • Shared group match history
OPEN SOURCE

An open project.

21Life’s code is available on GitHub under the MIT licence. Explore it, report issues and suggest improvements.

Explore the source ↗

One account for Android and web

Sign in on your phone or in a browser to access your group, decks and games. Syncing data and importing decks require an internet connection.
